No submitted grade is provided. q-74629: the RREF has nonzero rows (1,0,-21,4) and (0,1,6,-1), giving x=21z+4 and y=-6z-1 with z free. q-74626: the nonzero RREF rows are (1,0,-10,-1) and (0,1,4,1), giving x=10z-1 and y=1-4z. q-131647: negating the first row gives (1,2,-4,3); the other rows are multiples and reduce to zero. q-74612: the second and third rows are -10 and -4 times the first, leaving (1,-10,-5,10) and two zero rows. q-33655: the point requires t=1; the velocity is (4,2,4), whose norm is 6, yielding (2/3,1/3,2/3). q-33584: the point requires t=1; the velocity is (2,2,1), whose norm is 3, yielding (2/3,2/3,1/3). Its source introduction incorrectly repeats the basis vector j in the first component; this authored typo does not affect the subsequent calculation or final answer. q-32247: elimination gives RREF rows (1,0,10,-8) and (0,1,-6,6), hence x₁=-8-10x₃ and x₂=6+6x₃ with x₃ free. q-42019: adding twice the second row to the first gives (1,0,0,0), so x=0 and y=z-1. q-131719: all equations are multiples of x+4y=-1, leaving one free variable and infinitely many solutions; only II is true. q-74634: elimination produces the contradictory equation 0=9/2, so the system is inconsistent and only III is true.",
